brief: A 7.7-magnitude earthquake in Indonesia has killed at least 14, wildfire and heatwave impacts are visible from space, and the Taliban mark five years in power amid growing international engagement. Notable research covers cybersecurity tensions in regulated industries and ethics in visualization research.
news_summary: A major earthquake struck Indonesia, causing fatalities; Europe faces heatwave risks; the Taliban celebrate five years in power; and a Picasso print was recovered after years.
papers_summary: Research highlights include balancing innovation with cybersecurity in regulated organizations and a call for better ethics reporting in visualization conferences.

zh.brief: 今日焦點包括台灣前總統陳水扁女兒陳幸妤離婚事件引發媒體倫理反思，韓國股市暴跌重創散戶，中國國產客機C919首飛國際航線挑戰波音與空巴；國際方面印尼強震致14死，歐洲熱浪與阿富汗局勢亦受關注。
zh.news_summary: 華文新聞聚焦台灣、韓國及中國的社會與經濟事件，而國際新聞則涵蓋印尼地震、阿富汗局勢及歐洲熱浪等，顯示全球各地不同挑戰並存。
zh.papers_summary: 研究方面，視覺化與人機互動領域關注倫理審查、貢獻聲明等議題，同時有針對神經科學與網絡安全的研究，顯示學術界持續探討技術與社會的互動。
